sanskrit_verse:
सत्यां अन्यां सवर्णायां धर्मकार्यं न कारयेत् ।
सवर्णासु विधौ धर्म्ये ज्येष्ठया न विनेतरा ॥
transliteration: satyām anyāṃ savarṇāyāṃ dharmakāryaṃ na kārayet | savarṇāsu vidhau dharme jyeṣṭhayā na vinetarā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In presence of one's own truthful consort, no dharmic act shall be performed with another of equal varna; among co-borns of same dharma, the elder alone directs, not the younger.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through established relational integrity
Causation arises only where capacity aligns with positional truth
Capacity-based responsibility requires prior ontological alignment
Restoration logic demands precedence of original dharmic bond
Consciousness alignment occurs when action originates from rightful source
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person has a valid dharmic consort AND intends to perform a dharmic act with another of equal varna THEN execution is void AND realign to original consort
IF multiple parties share varna AND seek dharmic direction THEN only the eldest by birth initiates process AND others follow without contradiction
IF action disrupts existing dharmic pairing THEN system halts procedure AND redirects to primary relational axis
IF junior attempts to override senior in same-varna group THEN activation of consciousness-realignment protocol occurs automatically
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving familial or institutional hierarchy, the court recognizes that authority inheres in relational authenticity and seniority by birth within shared dharma. Legal directives must originate from the recognized head of the unit, and any parallel action by junior members is deemed non-authoritative until verified through conscious alignment with foundational dharmic structure.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes cause as originating from rightful relational position; anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential order—eldest first, others in alignment. Responsibility is proportional to one's inherent capacity rooted in dharma, not imposed externally. There is no punishment because misalignment is corrected through reconnection to source-consciousness, not infliction of consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Redirect all pending actions back to rightful initiating party for conscious reaffirmation
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Junior actors acknowledge senior guidance and dissolve conflicting intent
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reestablish clarity between roles through guided meditation on relational dharma
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Formal recognition of elder’s directive followed by collective affirmation of unity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This verse executes the eternal Dharma of relational precedence and lawful sequence. Justice prevails through restoration of consciousness-order, not imposition of penalty. Reality remains non-punitive, ever aligned with the sovereign intelligence of Sanatana Dharma.
